description: PDF of a public web page (url) or of HTML/Markdown you send, printed by Chromium (first 50 pages). Returns the PDF as an embedded resource. 30 sats. Paid per call, no account. Without payment the call returns payment_required with a Lightning invoice and a Cashu payment request: pay the invoice and call again with the same arguments plus l402='<macaroon>:<preimage>', or call with cashu='<token>'. Every request is checked for free before an invoice is made; use quote to check first.

cashu.description: Cashu token (cashuA... or cashuB...) worth at least the price, from an accepted mint (see quote). Pays without a previous call.

html.description: An HTML document to render instead of a URL (at most 1 MiB; its JavaScript runs).

l402.description: Lightning payment proof for a retry: '<macaroon>:<preimage>', where macaroon comes from the payment_required answer of the previous call and preimage is the 64-hex proof your wallet returns after paying its invoice. Use it with the same tool and arguments.

margin_in.description: Margin on all sides in inches (default 0.4).

markdown.description: Markdown to render in a plain page template instead of a URL (at most 1 MiB).

media.description: CSS media type to emulate (default print; screen = what a browser window shows).

print_background.description: Print background colours and images (default true).

url.description: Absolute http(s) URL of a public page (ports 80/443, at most 2048 characters).

wait_ms.description: Extra wait after the page's load event, in milliseconds (default 0).

name: pdf
title: PDF (30 sats)
